jobs.title: Health Data Analyst
jobs.description:
About UHIN

What if you could use your talent to have a positive impact on healthcare? As a nonprofit, Utah Health Information Network, UHIN for short is a health information technology (HIT) company that is making a difference by breaking down the barriers & inefficiencies that exist in healthcare. We offer affordable technology products that allows providers, payers, and patients to securely run their business, take care of patients, and improve affordability.

Why work here? We are an innovative organization recognized for being one of the nation’s leaders in standardized information exchange. So how do we do it? It’s no secret, we owe the past 30 years of our success to our outstanding and talented team members.

How is Our Technology Used? We aggregate, transform, and exchange large amounts of healthcare data. Our data significantly helps the biggest healthcare organizations in the world make decisions.

Additional Information

* Occasional Travel requirements to UT or conferences .
* The position has remote and flex-work policies.
* Disability accommodations.
* We are technologists and innovators committed to the pursuit of equitable healthcare. But health equity is not possible without representation. Our commitment to diversity goes beyond demographics or checking boxes. Our people must reflect the diverse identities, experiences and backgrounds of the communities and customers we serve – because that’s what our society, colleagues and communities deserve.
* This position may be exposed to PHI on a regular basis; however, only accesses the minimum necessary for completing tasks. In doing so, this position must comply with all UHIN Policies and Procedures with specific regard to PHI Privacy and Security sections and maintain confidentiality regarding the information being processed, stored, or accessed by the network.

Job Summary

The Health Data Analyst (PHIG) is responsible for assessing and improving health data quality, performing advanced statistical analyses, and designing interactive reporting and visualization tools. Operating at the intersection of public health surveillance, clinical data, and claims databases, this role extracts complex datasets to support chronic disease monitoring, quality metrics, and population health initiatives. The position supports UHIN’s transition toward a data-driven culture by delivering actionable insights, advancing data governance, and maintaining strict regulatory compliance.

Qualifications - Education, Experience and Skills

**Required qualifications**:

Education & Experience:

* Bachelor’s degree in Healthcare Informatics, Epidemiology, Public Health, Data Analytics, Statistics, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* Minimum 2–4 years of experience extracting, analyzing, interpreting, and reporting on complex healthcare and public health data.
* Demonstrated experience working with both healthcare claims and clinical datasets.

Domain & Analytical Expertise:

* Hands-on experience with public health surveillance, chronic disease reporting, and population-level health analytics.
* Proven track record assessing health data quality, accuracy, completeness, and timeliness across disparate internal and external systems.

Technical & Software Proficiency:

* Advanced SQL query development for complex data extraction, aggregation, and manipulation.
* Experience with Python (including data visualization and statistical libraries).
* Experience designing, developing, and maintaining interactive dashboards using Business Intelligence tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).

Skills, Knowledge, and Abilities:

* Technical & Data Mastery: Proficiency in writing optimized SQL queries, utilizing Python/R libraries, building BI dashboards, applying statistical and research methods, and analyzing both structured and unstructured quantitative and qualitative data.
* Analytical & Critical Thinking: Ability to identify complex problems, weigh pros/cons (cost/benefit), perform quantitative and qualitative analyses, evaluate system performance metrics, and draw logical, data-backed conclusions.
* Communication & Stakeholder Engagement: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills to interpret and translate complex data findings into clear, non-technical actionable recommendations for medical directors, clinicians, public health partners, and executive leadership teams.
* Data Governance & Security: In-depth knowledge of HIPAA regulations and internal data governance policies, maintaining absolute confidentiality, privacy, and security across all data operations.
* Organization & Collaboration: Strong time management, self-initiative, and prioritization skills, with a demonstrated ability to lead meetings, manage projects, and collaborate effectively across teams and external stakeholders.

**Preferred qualifications**:

* Master’s degree with specialized training in research methods and statistical analysis in a healthcare or public health domain (e.g., Informatics, Epidemiology).
* Public health epidemiological experience.
* Experience with machine learning algorithms, predictive analytics, and Natural Language Processing (NLP) for unstructured healthcare data.
* Familiarity with additional programming languages and tools: R, JavaScript, Google BigQuery, and healthcare industry data standards.

**PHYSICAL or MENTAL DEMANDS**

The physical demands described here are representatives of those that must be met by an

employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable

accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential

functions.

* While performing the duties of this Job, the employee is regularly required to sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel and reach with hands and arms and lift up to 40lbs.
* Frequently required to talk or hear. Specific vision abilities required by this job include ability to adjust focus at a computer for extended periods of time.

jobs.description:
Knock is redefining the home buying and selling experience, and we're only getting started! We're a passionate team of industry experts who knew there had to be a better, simpler way for people to navigate the journey between homes. That people-first mindset is core to how we operate, and why Knock has been honored as one of *Inc.'s Best Workplaces* six times in the past seven years.

We bring that mindset into the work we do every day. The Knock Bridge Loan™ empowers homebuyers to 'buy before they sell', by unlocking the equity in their current home, giving them greater convenience, certainty, and competitiveness.

Founded in 2015, Knock has grown into a trusted partner for thousands of homebuyers and a network of 60,000+ loan officers and agents across the country. Backed by top investors like Foundry Group, Trinity Capital, and the National Association of Realtors, we've built a reputation for innovation and trust, earning 900+ five-star Zillow and Trustpilot reviews and an A+ BBB rating.

Join our growing team and help shape the future of homebuying! To learn more, visit Knock.com

**Business Analyst**  
  
This role is ideal for someone excited to work with data, reporting, and business process automation. The Business Analyst will partner closely with senior analysts to support business reporting, improve data quality and availability, and collaborate with sales and operations on process automation initiatives. This role focuses on ensuring data and dashboards are clean, well-organized, and effectively used across teams, while also playing a key role in standardizing data and connecting multiple data sources to drive automation.

**What You'll Do:**

**Own and Advance Business-Critical Reporting:**

* Design, build, and maintain dashboards within Knock's reporting platforms (e.g., Tableau) used for management and executive reporting
* Establish repeatable, standardized reporting processes that ensure accuracy, consistency, and reliability across the organization
* Apply independent judgment to determine appropriate metrics, data sources, and presentation methods to support informed decision-making
* Partner with business leaders to translate complex data into actionable insights

**Ensure Data Accuracy, Integrity, and Governance:**

* Own data quality standards across systems to ensure reporting accuracy and trust
* Normalize, clean, and structure data tables to support long-term scalability and maintainability
* Define, document, and enforce data definitions, naming conventions, and field mappings across multiple platforms
* Handle sensitive and confidential information, including PII, in compliance with internal security standards and data privacy best practices

**Create, Improve, and Maintain Processes & Pipelines:**

* Design and document processes and procedures for data workflows, reporting, and automation
* Make thoughtful changes to existing business-critical processes with minimal disruption to operations
* Maintain and optimize data pipelines to ensure speed, reliability, and accuracy without causing business interruptions
* Independently identify gaps, risks, and inefficiencies in current systems and recommend solutions

**Drive Automation and Cross-Functional Enablement:**

* Learn and understand existing workflows and automations across teams
* Evaluate and improve existing automations across sales, marketing, and operations
* Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to understand workflows and design scalable, data-driven solutions
* Take ownership of ongoing maintenance, monitoring, and improvement of automation logic and outputs
* Identify and drive opportunities to improve and simplify current automations

**What You'll Bring:**

* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to exercise independent judgment and solve complex business problems
* Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets, including formulas, lookups, and pivot tables
* Working knowledge of SQL (joins, conditional logic); familiarity with Python, JSON structures, and delimited text formats is a plus
* Experience with data visualization tools (nice to have: experience with Tableau, Power BI, or Looker)
* Experience developing, maintaining, and validating data used for management reporting and operational decision-making
* Experience cleaning, organizing, and maintaining data from CRMs or spreadsheets
* Experience collaborating with marketing, sales, or operations teams on reporting or process improvement initiatives
* Strong attention to detail, particularly when cleaning, mapping, and labeling data, and the ability to identify data inconsistencies or errors
* Clear and effective communicator with the ability to simplify complex concepts
* Ability to work independently, prioritize work, and adapt to changing business needs without close supervision
* Agility in adapting to changing processes, new situations, and thinking on one's feet
* Resourcefulness, decisiveness and accountability for the customer and agent experience
* Demonstrated ability to perform under pressure, meet deadlines, and manage multiple priorities simultaneously
* Outstanding work ethic and commitment to delivering high-quality results
* Passion for Knock's POPSICLE values and a consistent commitment to doing the right thing
* **Education:**Bachelor's degree
* **Experience:** Minimum of 1 year in an analytical, reporting, or technical support role

We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every qualification. If this role excites you, we want to hear from you!

jobs.title: Service Desk Lead / Program Manager - VA C&P Help Desk 2.0 (Remote)
jobs.description:
Triumph Enterprises, Inc. is recruiting a **Service Desk Lead / Program Manager** for our proposed support to the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Office of Information and Technology, Compensation and Pension (C&P) Product Line Help Desk Tier 2 and Deployment Support Services 2.0. **This position is contingent upon contract award.** Remote work from anywhere in the United States.

**ABOUT THE WORK**

The Service Desk Lead manages Triumph's Tier 2 service desk and release support team for a Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) claims-processing product line. You own delivery to the service-level agreements, lead a remote team of analysts across extended hours, and are the contractor's primary point of contact with the VA program office.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

* Plan, monitor and control all work; maintain the project management plan and bi-weekly progress reports, including workforce staffing data
* Lead the 60-day transition-in: knowledge transfer, staff onboarding, background investigation tracking and Government-furnished equipment (GFE)
* Run the Tier 2 service desk: staffing schedules across 102 coverage hours a week, 24/7 on-call rotation, two-senior-analyst review before escalation
* Notify the VA C&P Service Desk Manager and Contracting Officer's Representative (COR) of high/critical priority incidents within 30 minutes and provide hourly updates
* Represent the team at daily C&P and Enterprise Operations calls; provide subject matter expert support to C&P managers
* Lead transition-out if exercised

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* Able to read, write, speak and understand English
* Able to obtain and keep a VA Tier 2 / Moderate Risk background investigation; complete VA privacy and security training and sign the Contractor Rules of Behavior before system access
* 7+ years in IT service desk or application support, including 3+ years leading Tier 2 teams of 10 or more
* Experience managing to service-level agreements in ServiceNow
* Bachelor's degree, or 4 additional years of relevant experience in lieu of a degree
* Able to travel about once a year (2 days; Charleston, SC or Washington, DC)

**PREFERRED CERTIFICATIONS**

* Project Management Professional (PMP) or Certified Associate in Project Management (CAPM)
* ITIL 4 Foundation
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (Triumph will sponsor the exam for the selected candidate)

**OTHER PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Current VA or other federal Public Trust / Moderate Risk investigation (reciprocity to be confirmed)
* Experience with VA Veterans Benefits Management System (VBMS) or Veterans Benefits Administration (VBA) claims applications
* Federal contract transition experience

**SCHEDULE AND LOCATION**

Remote within the United States; core hours Eastern; escalation point for 24/7 on-call; 1 trip a year.

**WHY TRIUMPH**

Triumph Enterprises, Inc. is a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business headquartered in Fairfax, Virginia, operating under an ISO 9001:2015-certified quality management system. We price our work based on local market wages, ensuring we fairly compensate our team rather than paying the bare minimum.

Triumph Enterprises, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We hire strictly on the basis of qualifications and merit, providing equal consideration to all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

jobs.description:

ViaPath is seeking an Associate (Entry Level) Intelligence Analyst to join our team working with our clients. The responsibility of the Intelligence Associate Analyst will be to provide direct support to the customer staff. While in this critical position, you will have the opportunity to utilize your training and experience to assist Corrections Investigations staff in the development of actionable intelligence within the facilities or approved outside law enforcement agencies within established time frames. The selected candidate will be team oriented, capable of multitasking, and possess excellent communication skills.

This primarily remote/virtual position **must be** **based in the Columbus, OH area**, with a requirement to travel to the client site in Columbus as needed.

Responsibilities:

* Analyze data to establish trends within the facility and potential areas of interest
* Assist facility with investigations by utilizing specialized software provided for data mining and link analysis
* Monitor offender telephone calls
* Establish a fundamental understanding of the facility’s operation to include policies and procedures, and data sources available for analysis

jobs.description:

Our data-powered platform simplifies processes and streamlines systems, helping those we serve create tighter bonds with their customers. From prescription management and pet owner engagement to veterinary business performance data and insights, Vetsource provides comprehensive solutions that give our customers more time and flexibility, and help them foster strong relationships and positive experiences. In a rapidly evolving world, we’re constantly seeking new ways to help our customers chart a course for a better, brighter future for pets and those who care for them.

If you love pets, want to have an impact and join a fantastic organization, Vetsource could be the place for you.

*At Vetsource, our teams, much like our customers, are represented through diverse perspectives, life experiences, unique strengths (and love for animals). We are an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace.*

*We are a team of real people looking for great people to join us, which is why applications are carefully and thoughtfully reviewed by our team. We know that when considering a new opportunity, it's common to weigh your qualifications against the listed job criteria. That said, even if you don’t meet 100% of the job requirements but feel you would be a good fit for the role, we still encourage you to apply!*

Support and train end users.

jobs.title: Restaurant Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Summary

Leland Eating and Drinking House is seeking an analytical and detail-oriented Restaurant Operations Analyst to evaluate operational performance, review business data, and identify opportunities to improve restaurant efficiency and service quality. The successful candidate will analyze sales trends, labor costs, inventory usage, customer feedback, and daily operating reports to help management make informed business decisions.

The ideal candidate has strong analytical skills, an understanding of restaurant operations, and the ability to translate data into practical recommendations. This position works closely with restaurant management, kitchen personnel, and service teams to support operational improvements and consistent customer experiences.

Key Responsibilities

* Analyze daily, weekly, and monthly restaurant performance data, including sales, transaction volumes, and service activity.
* Prepare operational reports, dashboards, and summaries for management review.
* Monitor key performance indicators related to revenue, labor utilization, inventory, customer satisfaction, and service efficiency.
* Review sales trends and identify patterns that may affect restaurant performance.
* Analyze food costs, inventory consumption, waste, and purchasing records to identify potential savings.
* Evaluate staffing levels, scheduling patterns, and labor costs against business needs.
* Review customer feedback and service reports to identify recurring concerns and improvement opportunities.
* Collaborate with kitchen and front-of-house teams to understand operational challenges and recommend practical solutions.
* Assess restaurant workflows and identify opportunities to improve productivity and coordination.
* Support budgeting, forecasting, and operational planning by preparing relevant data and analysis.
* Verify the accuracy and consistency of information obtained from point-of-sale systems, inventory records, and other business sources.
* Track the results of operational changes and report on their effectiveness.
* Assist management in establishing measurable performance targets and monitoring progress.
* Maintain organized analytical documentation and protect confidential business information.
* Perform additional analytical and administrative duties as assigned.

Qualifications and Requirements

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Hospitality Management, Economics, Statistics, Data Analytics, or a related field preferred.
* Previous experience in restaurant operations, business analysis, hospitality, or data reporting is an advantage.
* Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving abilities.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or similar spreadsheet applications.
* Ability to interpret numerical information and communicate findings clearly.
* Familiarity with sales reports, inventory records, labor data, and operational performance metrics.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and meet reporting deadlines.
* Professional judgment when handling confidential financial and operational information.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with management and restaurant staff.

Preferred Skills

* Experience with restaurant point-of-sale (POS) systems and reporting tools.
* Familiarity with business intelligence platforms or data visualization software.
* Understanding of food cost percentages, labor cost ratios, inventory turnover, and sales forecasting.
* Knowledge of restaurant workflow optimization and service quality measurement.
* Ability to identify trends, explain variances, and develop actionable recommendations.
* Experience preparing dashboards, performance summaries, or management presentations.
* Strong organizational skills and a continuous-improvement mindset.

Work Environment

The Restaurant Operations Analyst works in a restaurant business environment, collaborating with management and operational teams. The position primarily involves reviewing data, preparing reports, evaluating performance, and communicating recommendations. Occasional observation of restaurant service, inventory processes, or kitchen workflows may be necessary to understand operational conditions and validate findings.

Benefits

Depending on company policy, employment status, and eligibility, benefits may include:

* Competitive compensation based on experience and qualifications.
* Opportunities for professional development in restaurant analytics and business operations.
* Training in reporting systems and operational performance measurement.
* Potential advancement into Senior Operations Analyst, Business Intelligence Analyst, or Restaurant Operations Manager positions.
* A collaborative environment with opportunities to contribute to business improvements.
* Paid time off or other employment benefits where offered by the employer.

About the Company

Leland Eating and Drinking House is the company associated with this opportunity. The Restaurant Operations Analyst supports management by reviewing business performance, identifying operational trends, and helping improve the efficiency of restaurant activities. This role contributes to informed decision-making by connecting operational data with practical recommendations for service, staffing, inventory, and cost management.

How to Apply

Interested candidates should submit an updated résumé highlighting relevant experience in data analysis, business reporting, restaurant operations, or hospitality management. Applicants should emphasize their analytical abilities, spreadsheet skills, attention to detail, and capacity to communicate data-driven recommendations.

Candidates who enjoy solving operational problems and using data to improve business performance are encouraged to apply.

Pay: $20.00 - $22.00 per year

Benefits:

* Relocation assistance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst - Emerging Payments & AirKey
jobs.description:
Senior Data Analyst - Emerging Payments & AirKey

At Capital One, data is at the center of everything we do. When we launched as a startup we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Analyst at Capital One you will leverage analytic and technical skills to innovate, build, and maintain well-managed data solutions and capabilities to tackle business problems.

On any given day you will be challenged by three types of work – Innovation, Business Intelligence and Data Management:

**Innovation**

* Use Open Source/Digital technologies to mine complex, voluminous, and different varieties of data sources and platforms
* Build well-managed data solutions, tools, and capabilities to enable self-service frameworks for data consumers
* Demonstrate ability to explore and quickly grasp new technologies to progress varied initiatives

**Business Intelligence**

* Partner with the business to provide consultancy and translate the business needs to design and develop tools, techniques, metrics, and dashboards for insights and data visualization
* Drive analysis that provides meaningful insights on business strategies

**Data Management**

* Drive an understanding and adherence to the principles of data quality management including metadata, lineage, and business definitions
* Work collaboratively with appropriate Tech teams to manage security mechanisms and data access governance
* Build and execute tools to monitor and report on data quality

**Our ideal candidate will have:**

* Degree specialized in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics discipline
* Scripting experience in (Python, R, Spark, and SQL)
* Strong desire and experience with data in various forms (data warehouses/SQL, unstructured data)
* Experience utilizing and developing within Snowflake services

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Bachelor’s Degree in quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science or a related quantitative field) plus at least 2 years of experience performing data analytics, or currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Master’s Degree with an expectation that required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date.
* At least 1 year of experience working with at least one scripting language
* At least 1 year of experience utilizing business intelligence visualization tool
* At least 1 year of experience querying, analyzing and working with data languages and platforms

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Master’s Degree in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics discipline

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager – Oracle Fusion ERP
jobs.description:
### **Role Overview**

We are seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager to lead critical stages of an ongoing Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP implementation. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on implementation experience and a proven track record of managing **User Acceptance Testing (UAT), data migration, cutover, and go-live** activities.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end project delivery for Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP implementation.
* Manage UAT planning, execution, defect resolution, and business sign-off.
* Oversee data migration, validation, reconciliation, and cutover planning.
* Drive go-live readiness, deployment, and post-go-live stabilization.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders, business teams, and implementation partners.
* Manage project timelines, risks, dependencies, and issue resolution.
* Ensure successful delivery within agreed scope, timelines, and quality standards.

### **Required Skills & Experience**

* Minimum 15 years of overall project management experience.
* Strong hands-on experience managing Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP implementations.
* Proven experience leading UAT, data migration, cutover, and go-live phases.
* Strong stakeholder management, leadership, and vendor coordination skills.
* Excellent communication, risk management, and project delivery capabilities.

**Skills:** Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP , Project Management , Stakeholder Management

jobs.title: End-to-End Marketing Project Manager IV, Brand Strategy
jobs.description:
**Overview:** Kaiser Permanente-s Enterprise Marketing team drives growth, retention, and brand relevance across multiple lines of business. The *Marketing Project Manager IV-Brand Strategy* will collaborate with other project managers and Brand Strategy team members to lead the end-to-end delivery of complex marketing projects and campaigns-from intake and scoping through planning, execution, launch, and post-launch insights. The project manager will coordinate cross-functional teams (e.g., strategy, brand, creative, IT, facilities, and HR) to keep work moving, manage timelines and risks, and ensure deliverables align with business objectives, established brand governance standards, and the enterprise brand strategy.

This role leverages strong creative experience along with Project Management Professional (PMP) expertise to support a multi-year enterprise brand transformation initiative. The project manager will apply strong marketing problem-solving skills, operate effectively in a matrixed environment, and bring structure and predictability to fast-moving, high-visibility brand strategy and transformation work.

**Job Summary:**

In addition to the responsibilities listed below, this senior individual contributor position is responsible for leading or assisting in the management of operational aspects of creative and/or marketing for a variety KP products, projects, and initiatives; coordinating multi-channel and multi-platform strategic marketing campaigns; ensuring that the job intake, scheduling, assignment, and quality control procedures, along with the work provided by support vendors, produce the high-quality deliverables required for overall project success; monitoring and tracking project budgets, invoices, scoping, scheduling, and prioritization; overseeing job trafficking, reporting, supply ordering, vendor relations and billing, job archiving, equipment and maintenance, and legal and compliance review; administering project management software; and ensuring that required department records are kept up to date and available for internal/external audit or oversight review.

This role is also responsible for providing end-to-end logistical support to marketing, creative, and production teams; establishing and upholding service level agreements between creative teams and other internal departments, including stakeholder management, production schedules, and project related vendor deliverables; managing all creative and editorial services production activities, including reviewing creative briefs, assigning jobs, prioritizing work, securing approvals, and expediting crisis jobs; assisting in the technical preparation of vendor files, finalization of job specifications, blue line and other proofing reviews, and distribution for approvals; providing innovative production solutions for ensuring products are on time and on budget; and contributing to internal department initiatives, including updating and creating processes, documentation, tools, etc.

**Essential Responsibilities:**

* Promotes learning in others by proactively providing and/or developing information, resources, advice, and expertise with coworkers and members; builds relationships with cross-functional/external stakeholders and customers. Listens to, seeks, and addresses performance feedback; proactively provides actionable feedback to others and to managers. Pursues self-development; creates and executes plans to capitalize on strengths and develop weaknesses; leads by influencing others through technical explanations and examples and provides options and recommendations. Adopts new responsibilities; adapts to and learns from change, challenges, and feedback; demonstrates flexibility in approaches to work; champions change and helps others adapt to new tasks and processes. Facilitates team collaboration to support a business outcome.
* Completes work assignments autonomously and supports business-specific projects by applying expertise in subject area and business knowledge to generate creative solutions; encourages team members to adapt to and follow all procedures and policies. Collaborates cross-functionally and/or externally to achieve effective business decisions; provides recommendations and solves complex problems; escalates high-priority issues or risks, as appropriate; monitors progress and results. Supports the development of work plans to meet business priorities and deadlines; identifies resources to accomplish priorities and deadlines. Identifies, speaks up, and capitalizes on improvement opportunities across teams; uses influence to guide others and engages stakeholders to achieve appropriate solutions.
* Manages large-scale projects from initiation to close-out. Develops, analyzes, and manages moderately complex project plans which include scope identification and management, schedule, inter-dependencies, and resource forecast. Manages and monitors project financials for large projects. Monitors overall project performance (e.g., on time, on budget, within scope, and with quality) against plan, ensuring measurement of business benefits and outcomes, and makes adjustments as needed. Manages project activities related to organizational change management (e.g., development and execution of user adoption, implementation, and training plans) as defined by the project. Drives allocation of resources, establishes schedules, and task assignments to ensure established project management practices are in place.
* Leads the work of project team members. Requests and coordinates internal and/ or external resources based on the alignment of team member skills and project demands. Promotes project vision and objectives with project team. Delivers performance feedback to team members supervisors.
* Proactively monitors and identifies project risks, issues, and trigger events by developing mitigation plans and strategies; and resolving or escalating risks or issues as appropriate.
